incidents.name: Incident with Git Operations and Pull Requests

updates.body: Pull Requests is experiencing degraded performance. We are continuing to investigate.

We continue to investigate elevated response times for Git operations and pull requests. Some pull-request processing and Actions workflows are improving, but delays and failures persist. We're monitoring the impact and working to restore normal service.
Actions is experiencing degraded availability. We are continuing to investigate.

We're investigating elevated response times for Git operations and pull requests. GitHub Actions workflows that are triggered from Pull Requests are delayed. We're working to mitigate the impact and will share updates as we learn more.
Actions and Pull Requests are experiencing degraded availability. We are continuing to investigate.
We are investigating reports of degraded performance for Actions and Pull Requests
